```{r bls}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "/ooh/", domain = "www.bls.gov", bot  ="*"
```

```{r indeed, warning=FALSE}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "/jobs/", domain = "www.indeed.com", bot = "*"
)
```
Given that this returned TRUE it means we are allowed to scrape this webpage.
